icon.$description: Icon semantic tokens. Separate from text because icon colour is routinely not text colour — an icon often needs more weight than the label beside it to read at the same size. Without these roles an adopted system's icon colours have to borrow a text role and stop being independently themeable.

default.$description: Default icon colour, paired with text.primary

muted.$description: De-emphasised icon — decorative, or paired with secondary text

on-action.$description: Icon sitting on an action surface, paired with text.on-action

accent.$description: Icon carrying the accent colour, such as a leading icon in a link
